blocks.text: Two titles now streaming on HBO Max are giving us contrasting approaches to something close to Filipino culture: show business. Call My Manager is about the people who make the stars; Michael is about what happens when the star becomes bigger than everyone around him. Both are as revealing as they are entertaining. In an article, director and showrunner Erik Matti calls the eight-part series Call My Manager “a love letter to Philippine showbiz” from the point of view of talent managers, producers, assistants, fans, and publicists.
